app_tagline: Check suspicious messages and learn how to protect yourself from digital fraud.
model_advanced_unavailable: Advanced model is not installed. Using the standard method.
input_placeholder: Paste the message you received here...
privacy_note_input: Your message is only checked, not saved. Never type your OTP or PIN anywhere except the official app.
err_too_long: This message is too long. Please paste a shorter one (up to {max} characters).
err_generic: Something went wrong while checking the message. Please try again.
headline_MEDIUM: Some warning signs - check before you act
summary_LOW: We did not find obvious fraud patterns. This does not guarantee the message is safe. Never share your OTP or PIN with anyone.
summary_MEDIUM: This message has some warning signs. Do not act on it yet. Check it with your bank or the company using a number you already trust.
summary_HIGH: This message has several signs that scammers use. Do not click any link, do not call any number in it, and never share your OTP, PIN or bank details.
summary_UNKNOWN: We cannot confidently assess this message. Please verify it independently - call your bank on the number printed on your card or passbook, or ask someone you trust.
uncertain_too_short: The message is too short for us to judge.
uncertain_unsupported_language: We could not recognise the language well, and our checks are only tested for English, Hindi and Hinglish.
uncertain_model_only_limited: Our computer model leans suspicious, but we found no specific warning sign and the model has been tested only lightly on this kind of message.
uncertain_ml_ambiguous: Our computer model is unsure about this message and we found no specific warning sign.
note_model_limited: The computer model has been tested only lightly on this language, so we gave it little weight.
note_model_ignored_language: The computer model has not been tested on this language, so this result uses our warning-sign checks only.
note_model_unavailable: The computer model is not available right now, so this result uses our warning-sign checks only.
note_weak_signal_only: Only a minor sign was found (for example urgent wording). That is common in genuine messages too.
note_model_only: No specific warning sign was found, but the message looks very similar to unwanted messages we have seen.
note_benign: The message looks like a normal notice.
note_low_language_confidence: We are not sure about the language of this message. You can choose the language yourself above.
reason_model: A computer model that learned from example messages also found this message similar to unwanted or fraudulent ones. This is a hint, not proof.
sec_highlight: Your message, with warning words marked
none_found: No specific warning signs were found.
url_not_opened: We did not open this link. Please do not tap it.
url_unusual: Unusual structure (this does not prove the link is harmful)
url_nothing_unusual: No unusual structure found (this does not prove the link is safe)
voice_failed: We could not create audio (internet may be needed). Please read the text above.
voice_unavailable: Audio is not available in this setup. Please read the text above.
fb_voluntary: Feedback is voluntary. We store only your answer and the result level - never the message itself.
fb_consent: I agree to store my feedback (the message is NOT stored)
fb_thanks: Thank you. Your feedback was saved.
fb_need_consent: Please tick the box to agree before sending feedback.
fb_error: Feedback could not be saved right now. Your result is not affected.
disclaimer_general: No tool can promise a message is safe. When in doubt, check with your bank or someone you trust.
quiz_intro: Read each message and decide: does it look genuine or suspicious? You will see an explanation after every answer. There are no wrong answers here - this is for learning.
aw_intro: Scammers use fear, hurry and greed. Learn the common tricks below.
about_what: GramSuraksha AI helps people understand whether an SMS may be a scam, explains the reasons in simple Hindi or English, and tells you what to do next. It is a prototype to support - not replace - your own care and your bank's advice.
about_p1: Your message is analysed and then forgotten. We do not keep an SMS history.
about_p2: We never open or visit links in your message.
about_p3: Feedback is saved only if you agree. It never includes your message. Sharing a message for review is a separate choice, and you can delete it later with your code.
about_p4: We do not collect OTPs, PINs or account numbers.
about_l1: We can never say a message is 100% safe or 100% a scam.
about_l2: The computer model is small and was trained on limited examples. Hindi and Hinglish support is the least tested.
about_l3: A link that looks normal can still be harmful, and an unusual link can be harmless.
about_help_text: Report cyber fraud at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930. Report suspicious messages at sancharsaathi.gov.in. If you have lost money, call your bank immediately.
uncertain_internal_inconsistency: The result was inconsistent inside the system, so we cannot give a reliable answer. Please verify the message independently.
home_how: Paste a message, upload a screenshot, or speak it. Then press “Check this message”.
img_upload: Upload a screenshot of the SMS
img_hint: PNG, JPG or WEBP, up to 5 MB. The picture is read in memory and is not saved.
btn_read_image: Read the text from the picture
ocr_label: Text found in the picture (you can correct it)
ocr_edit: Please check and correct the text, especially web links. Then press “Check this message”.
ocr_low: The picture was hard to read. Please check every word carefully.
ocr_empty: No text was found. Try a clearer screenshot, or type the message.
ocr_unavailable: Reading pictures is not set up on this server. Please type or paste the message.
ocr_hindi_missing: Hindi reading is not installed here, so Hindi words in the picture may be wrong.
ocr_timeout: Reading the picture took too long. Try a smaller or clearer picture.
ocr_truncated: The text was very long and was cut. Please check it.
err_image_too_large: The picture is too big (limit 5 MB).
err_image_not_an_image: This file is not a valid picture.
err_image_unsupported_format: Please use a PNG, JPG or WEBP picture.
err_image_too_many_pixels: The picture is too large in size. Please use a normal phone screenshot.
err_image_too_small: The picture is too small to read.
voice_intro: Record the message by voice, or dictate it with your browser.
voice_edit: Text heard (please correct it if needed)
voice_no_engine: Voice recognition is not set up on this server. You can dictate with your browser below and then paste the text in the “Paste text” tab.
err_audio_not_wav: The recording could not be read.
err_audio_unsupported: This recording format is not supported.
err_audio_too_long: The recording is too long (limit 60 seconds).
err_audio_silent: No speech was heard. Please try again.
tts_no_voice: This device has no Hindi voice, so audio cannot be played in Hindi. Please read the text.
dict_copied: Copied. Paste it in the “Paste text” tab.
fb_comment: Anything to add? (optional - please do not write personal details)
storage_off: Feedback is not available right now.
contrib_text: You can share this message so reviewers can use it to improve detection. Numbers, phone numbers and e-mail addresses are removed first. This is separate from feedback.
contrib_preview: This is exactly what would be saved:
contrib_consent: I agree to share this message for review
contrib_done: Thank you. Save this code - it lets you delete your message later:
contrib_dup: This message was already shared. Thank you.
contrib_not_found: No message found for this code.
admin_locked: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
admin_disabled: Staff login is not set up on this server.
admin_required: This page is for authorised staff only.
about_p5: Screenshots and voice recordings are processed in memory and are not saved.
threat_optin: Also check links with an online safety service (the link addresses are sent to that service)
